thread:
Asha: Quick QA on the product launch blog draft — I've pushed v3 to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-v3. Need final voice pass + confirm webinar CTA mapping to HubSpot flow. Can folks eyeball?

Tom: On it. I'll do a voice pass in ~1h. Any new benchmark numbers we should call out?

Lina: Bench callouts to use in the copy: p95 latency down 22% vs baseline, tokens/req cost ~-18%, sustained 2x throughput on Dedicated in our microbench. I have the plots in the slides — will paste short screenshots into the doc.

Priya: For CTAs we need two distinct registration flows — webinar (live demo) and API trial. Map to HS forms 'webinar_live' and 'api_trial'. @Ken can you confirm tracking params and zap mapping?

Ken: @Priya yes — proposed UTM params: utm_campaign=redwood_launch_v3, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Webinar link add ?ref=blog_webinar. Zapier mapping: webhook -> HS form 'webinar_live' -> tag: "webinar_blog_1716". I'll update the Zap.

Asha: Legal check: flagged claims are "2x throughput" and "industry-leading latency" — @Lina are those safe?

Lina: Legal ok with the numeric claim if we footnote measurement context. Replace "industry-leading" with "production-grade" to avoid subjective language. Add footnote: "Measured on Redwood internal test harness; results may vary."

Tom: Voice pass done — light edits in doc: tighten intro, swap "we're thrilled" -> "today we're announcing", remove a few exclamation points, tightened CTAs. Left 3 inline comments where I wasn't sure about a claim.

Priya: Webinar logistics: cap live attendees at 300. If demand >300, we do recording + follow-up office hours. Who's hosting? @Tom? Also we need slide deck + demo checklist.

Tom: I can host. Plan: 30-min demo (product walkthrough + benchmark slide), 15-min Q&A. I'll attach slides and a 5-step runbook.

Asha: Final approval checklist for handoff to ops: voice + legal + HS tracking + CTA copy. Approvers: @Priya @Ken @Tom @Lina. Please reply 'LGTM' or flag edits by EOD so Ops can start the HS form and registration page.

Priya: LGTM. One small copy ask: change CTA copy to exactly: 'Register for live demo' and 'Start free API trial'.

Ken: LGTM — I'll create HS forms + update zap mapping today and add the utm params.

Tom: LGTM. I'll resolve my two inline comments (clarify demo steps).

Lina: LGTM from legal. Reminder to include the footnote on benchmark claims: "Measured on Redwood internal test harness; results may vary."

Asha: :thumbsup: thanks all. Ops — @Maria-ops can you schedule the registration page publish for 2pm PT tomorrow and reserve the webinar room with vendor? Also sync with CS for follow-up emails.

Maria-ops: Got it — scheduling now. I'll confirm the registration page URL and room reservation by 5pm today. I'll also add CS to the follow-up email playbook.
